question.html:
A lift in a high-rise building starts from rest and moves upwards to the top floor. The motion consists of three distinct stages: first, it accelerates uniformly at for a duration of ; second, it travels at a constant velocity for ; third, it decelerates uniformly to rest in a final period of . Air resistance and friction are negligible.

a By considering the kinematics of each stage of the motion, determine the total vertical distance traveled by the lift from the start until it reaches the top floor. [4]

b

The lift starts its motion at . On the axes provided, draw a graph to show the variation with time of the acceleration of the lift from until it reaches the top floor. Mark the calculated numerical values of the acceleration on the vertical axis.
